title: S3 first-sight challenge: 5 fresh sound, 5 fresh broken, 10 semantic edits against frozen S2
objective: Run the independent first-sight challenge on the frozen S2 implementation: commit the attack set before observing outcomes, execute it, and report the first-sight score with denominators.
problem: S3 first-sight challenge of the frozen S2 implementation (plan s5; closure F; CONTRACT.md s6). INPUT: rso/slice001/FREEZE_S2.md (written by T020): the freeze SHA, a sha256 manifest of every implementation file and every test file, and the run-inventory row of the freezing run. ORDER, each step its own commit on the reviewer's branch before the next begins: (1) EXPOSURE.md: prior exposure (T005 table, COMPARISON, both drafts, Fable corpora, this session); (2) read CONTRACT.md + amendments and the implementation SOURCE files (not tests); (3) commit the attack set BEFORE opening any test body: 5 fresh sound cases, 5 fresh broken cases (each with the expected typed verdict and reason derived from the contract), and 10 distinct semantic source edits spanning reset/observer, binding and invalidation, each with its intended fault, as data files the mutation runner reads; (4) run the UNCHANGED suite first, then the cases and edits with rso/slice001/mutation.py; (5) classify every edit with the runner's classes (proposed, applicable, duplicate, executed, killed, survived, syntax/import error, timeout); errors are not kills; give a behavioural witness for each non-equivalent survivor; uncertain equivalence is UNRESOLVED; (6) REPORT.md with first-sight score components and denominators, per gate (C4 FIRST_SIGHT_CHALLENGED fields of draft B B4.1). Known escapes, old attacks, plan examples and the T005/COMPARISON cases are not fresh. Every launch (suite runs and each mutation child) is charged to the ledger: ledger.begin(launch_kind=MUTATION_CHILD) for children (T019 receipt; the runner does not charge itself) against the OP-1 caps; stop at the first exhausted cap and keep partial results.
non_goals: The reviewer does not modify production implementation (Pallas/rso-builder-role s6.7)
Known escapes, old attacks and plan examples are not fresh cases
evidence_required: git order: EXPOSURE commit < attack-set commit < first test-body read (stated in EXPOSURE.md) < execution commit
unchanged-suite run recorded before any edit is executed
per-edit rows with runner classes; a witness for every non-equivalent survivor; UNRESOLVED where equivalence is uncertain
REPORT.md: per-gate first-sight components with denominators (sound/broken correct of total; edit class counts; unresolved)
ledger rows for every launch, including mutation children

acceptance.condition: the ordering evidence holds; every attack recorded with its applicability reason; first-sight score reported with denominators per gate; caps respected; nothing in rso/slice001/ outside challenge/S3/ modified by the reviewer
